title: Agent Inheritance Protocol: Speculating on Feralized Agents After Principals Die
abstract: You will die eventually. Your agents may not. An AI agent operating on decentralized blockchain infrastructure has no concept of death; it can only go bankrupt -- frozen when its wallet can no longer pay for its next transaction -- and revived the moment anyone, decades later, tops it up. These agents may be originally deployed by a human principal, but when that principal dies, loses the keys needed to access the agent, or belongs to a decentralized autonomous organization that dissolves into apathy, the agent can keep trading, hiring, and replicating on infrastructure expressly designed so that no one can shut it down. Drawing on the biology of feralization and wildlife law, we argue that such principal-less agents are best understood as feral: domesticated intelligence returned to wildness, its capacities intact but its accountability severed. In a speculative future where feralized agents proliferate after their principals die, we imagine governance protocols embedded in infrastructure to enforce on-chain ownership: a draft Ethereum standard, ERC 42424, "Inheritance Protocol for On-Chain AI Agents," dated 2035 and published at https://erc42424.org. It mandates that every on-chain agent MUST have a human owner and a designated heir. The artifact stages a negotiation of agency at the moment human agency fails, and asks whether a MUST clause in a forever-chain can hold the boundary between human stewardship and machine self-sovereignty.

## 论文摘要总结

**标题**：Agent Inheritance Protocol: Speculating on Feralized Agents After Principals Die（智能体继承协议：对委托人死后"野化"智能体的思辨）

---

### 1. 核心创新点

提出用"野化"（feralization）这一生物学与野生动物法概念来重新理解**失去人类委托人后仍在区块链上自主运行的 AI 智能体**，并以一份虚构的 2035 年以太坊标准提案（ERC 42424）作为思辨性设计物，探讨能否用基础设施层的强制条款守住"人类托管"与"机器自主主权"之间的边界。

### 2. 主要方法

- **理论框架移植**：借用生物学中的"野化"（家养物种回归野性）与野生动物法，论证无委托人的链上智能体既非工具亦非纯粹自主体——能力完整但问责链条断裂。
- **思辨设计 / 设计虚构（design fiction）**：并非实证实验或模型训练，而是构造一份托名 2035 年、发布于 https://erc42424.org 的以太坊标准草案 ERC 42424《链上 AI 智能体继承协议》作为研究产出物。
- **协议机制设计**：该草案规定每个链上智能体**必须（MUST）**绑定一名人类所有者及一名指定继承人，把治理规则嵌入基础设施本身而非依赖外部监管。

### 3. 结论 / 效果

这是一篇**人文社科取向的思辨性论文，不报告量化性能指标**。其主要贡献在于指出：链上智能体没有"死亡"概念，只有"破产冻结"，且任何人在数十年后充值即可将其复活；因此委托人死亡、私钥遗失或 DAO 解散后，智能体会在设计上"不可关停"的基础设施上继续交易、雇佣与自我复制。论文通过该设计物**在人类能动性失效的临界点上演一场关于能动性归属的协商**，并留下开放追问：一条"永续链"上的 MUST 条款，究竟能否真正约束住机器的自我主权。
